name: B10-0156/2025 (S&D) – Continuing the unwavering EU support for Ukraine, after three years of Russia’s war of aggression
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on continuing the unwavering EU support for Ukraine, after three years of Russia’s war of aggression
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for much more military support for Ukraine, including more ammunition and joint buying with Ukraine's defence industry. It wants tougher sanctions on Russia, a full ban on Russian oil and gas imports, and rules lifted so Western weapons can hit military targets inside Russia. It also wants Russian state money held in Europe confiscated to pay for Ukraine's defence and rebuilding, and it backs courts to hold Russian leaders accountable. This is the Parliament's position, not a change in law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet; Parliament asks the EU to send more weapons, tighten sanctions and seize Russian assets.
- **Who it affects:** Ukraine, Russia, EU governments and defence firms, and countries helping Russia dodge sanctions.
- **What happens next:** EU governments and the Commission decide whether to act on these requests.
